sql:
SELECT 
    client_id,
    age,
    average_salary
FROM (
    SELECT 
        client_id,
        age,
        average_salary,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY age DESC) AS oldest_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY average_salary ASC) AS lowest_salary_rank
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            client_id,
            age,
            average_salary
        FROM (
            SELECT 
                c.client_id,
                EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.birth_date) AS age,
                d.A11 AS average_salary
            FROM 
                client c
            JOIN 
                district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
            WHERE 
                c.gender = 'F'
        )
    )
)
WHERE oldest_rank = 1 OR lowest_salary_rank = 1;

    client_id,

FROM (
    SELECT 
        client_id,
        age,
        average_salary,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY age DESC) AS oldest_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY average_salary ASC) AS lowest_salary_rank
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            client_id,
            age,
            average_salary
        FROM (
            SELECT 
                c.client_id,
                EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.birth_date) AS age,

                client c
            JOIN 
                district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id

    )
)
WHERE oldest_rank = 1 OR lowest_salary_rank = 1;

                client c

)

SELECT 
    client_id,

        client_id,

                d.A11 AS average_salary
            FROM 
                client c
            JOIN 
                district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id

                c.gender = 'F'
        )
    )
)

SELECT 
    client_id,
    age,
    average_salary
FROM (
    SELECT 
        client_id,
        age,
        average_salary,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY age DESC) AS oldest_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY average_salary ASC) AS lowest_salary_rank
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            client_id,
            age,
            average_salary
        FROM (
            SELECT 
                c.client_id,
                EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.birth_date) AS age,
                d.A11 AS average_salary
            FROM 
                client c
            JOIN 
                district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
            WHERE 
                c.gender = 'F'
        )
    )
)
WHERE oldest_rank = 1 OR lowest_salary_rank = 1;

WITH total_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
loans_with_no_issues AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
        AND loan.status = 'C'
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
percentage AS (
    SELECT 
        t.region,
        t.loan_size_category,
        (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
    FROM 
        total_loans t
    JOIN 
        loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
)
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average
FROM 
    percentage
ORDER BY 
    region;

    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'

        END
),

        t.region,
        t.loan_size_category,
        (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage

)

SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    (loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / total_loans) AS percentage_with_no_issues
FROM 
    (SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans
     FROM 
        loan
     JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
     JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
     JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
     WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
     GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END) AS total_loans_table
JOIN 
    (SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
     FROM 
        loan
     JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
     JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
     JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
     WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
        AND loan.status = 'C'
     GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END) AS no_issues_loans_table
ON 
    total_loans_table.region = no_issues_loans_table.region
    AND total_loans_table.loan_size_category = no_issues_loans_table.loan_size_category;

WITH total_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
loans_with_no_issues AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
        AND loan.status = 'C'
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
percentage AS (
    SELECT 
        t.region,
        t.loan_size_category,
        (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
    FROM 
        total_loans t
    JOIN 
        loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
)
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average
FROM 
    percentage
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;

sql:
WITH total_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
loans_with_no_issues AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
        AND loan.status = 'C'
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
percentage AS (
    SELECT 
        t.region,
        t.loan_size_category,
        (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
    FROM 
        total_loans t
    JOIN 
        loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
)
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average
FROM 
    percentage
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;
exec_sql: WITH total_loans AS (SELECT district.A2 AS region, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END AS loan_size_category, COUNT(*) AS total_loans FROM loan JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id JOIN client ON account.district_id = client.district_id JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id WHERE loan.amount < 100000 GROUP BY district.A2, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END), loans_with_no_issues AS (SELECT district.A2 AS region, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END AS loan_size_category, COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues FROM loan JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id JOIN client ON account.district_id = client.district_id JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id WHERE loan.amount < 100000 AND loan.status = 'C' GROUP BY district.A2, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END), percentage AS (SELECT t.region, t.loan_size_category, (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage FROM total_loans AS t JOIN loans_with_no_issues AS l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category) SELECT region, loan_size_category, percentage, (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average FROM percentage ORDER BY region, loan_size_category, 1 ASC, 2 ASC, 3 ASC, 4 ASC

sql:
WITH total_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
loans_with_no_issues AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
        AND loan.status = 'C'
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
percentage AS (

sql:
WITH total_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
loans_with_no_issues AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
        AND loan.status = 'C'
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
percentage AS (
    SELECT 
        t.region,
        t.loan_size_category,
        (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
    FROM 
        total_loans t
    JOIN 
        loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
)
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average
FROM 
    percentage
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;
exec_sql: WITH total_loans AS (SELECT district.A2 AS region, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END AS loan_size_category, COUNT(*) AS total_loans FROM loan JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id JOIN client ON account.district_id = client.district_id JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id WHERE loan.amount < 100000 GROUP BY district.A2, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END), loans_with_no_issues AS (SELECT district.A2 AS region, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END AS loan_size_category, COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues FROM loan JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id JOIN client ON account.district_id = client.district_id JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id WHERE loan.amount < 100000 AND loan.status = 'C' GROUP BY district.A2, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END), percentage AS (SELECT t.region, t.loan_size_category, (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage FROM total_loans AS t JOIN loans_with_no_issues AS l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category) SELECT region, loan_size_category, percentage, (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average FROM percentage ORDER BY region, loan_size_category, 1 ASC, 2 ASC, 3 ASC, 4 ASC

sql:
WITH total_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
loans_with_no_issues AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
        AND loan.status = 'C'
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
percentage AS (
    SELECT 
        t.region,
        t.loan_size_category,
        (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
    FROM 
        total_loans t
    JOIN 
        loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
)
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average
FROM 
    percentage

    s.CDSCode, 
    s.School, 
    s.Virtual,

WITH LatestLabResults AS (
    SELECT 
        Patient.ID, 
        Laboratory.UA, 
        Patient.SEX,
        Laboratory.Date AS LabDate
    FROM 
        Patient
    JOIN 
        Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Patient.ID ORDER BY Laboratory.Date DESC) = 1
)
SELECT 
    ID, 
    UA, 
    SEX
FROM 
    LatestLabResults
WHERE 
    (SEX = 'M' AND UA < 8.0) OR (SEX = 'F' AND UA < 6.5);

sql:
WITH total_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
loans_with_no_issues AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
        AND loan.status = 'C'
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
percentage AS (
    SELECT 
        t.region,
        t.loan_size_category,
        (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
    FROM 
        total_loans t
    JOIN 
        loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
)
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average
FROM 
    percentage
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;
exec_sql: WITH total_loans AS (SELECT district.A2 AS region, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END AS loan_size_category, COUNT(*) AS total_loans FROM loan JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id JOIN client ON account.district_id = client.district_id JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id WHERE loan.amount < 100000 GROUP BY district.A2, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END), loans_with_no_issues AS (SELECT district.A2 AS region, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END AS loan_size_category, COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues FROM loan JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id JOIN client ON account.district_id = client.district_id JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id WHERE loan.amount < 100000 AND loan.status = 'C' GROUP BY district.A2, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END), percentage AS (SELECT t.region, t.loan_size_category, (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage FROM total_loans AS t JOIN loans_with_no_issues AS l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category) SELECT region, loan_size_category, percentage, (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average FROM percentage ORDER BY region, loan_size_category, 1 ASC, 2 ASC, 3 ASC, 4 ASC

sql:
WITH total_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
loans_with_no_issues AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
        AND loan.status = 'C'
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
percentage AS (
    SELECT 
        t.region,
        t.loan_size_category,
        (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
    FROM 
        total_loans t
    JOIN 
        loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
)
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average
FROM 
    percentage
ORDER BY 
    region;

sql:
WITH total_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
loans_with_no_issues AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
        AND loan.status = 'C'
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
percentage AS (
    SELECT 
        t.region,
        t.loan_size_category,
        (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
    FROM 
        total_loans t
    JOIN 
        loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
)
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average
FROM 
    percentage
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;
exec_sql: WITH total_loans AS (SELECT district.A2 AS region, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END AS loan_size_category, COUNT(*) AS total_loans FROM loan JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id JOIN client ON account.district_id = client.district_id JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id WHERE loan.amount < 100000 GROUP BY district.A2, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END), loans_with_no_issues AS (SELECT district.A2 AS region, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END AS loan_size_category, COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues FROM loan JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id JOIN client ON account.district_id = client.district_id JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id WHERE loan.amount < 100000 AND loan.status = 'C' GROUP BY district.A2, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END), percentage AS (SELECT t.region, t.loan_size_category, (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage FROM total_loans AS t JOIN loans_with_no_issues AS l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category) SELECT region, loan_size_category, percentage, (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average FROM percentage ORDER BY region, loan_size_category, 1 ASC, 2 ASC, 3 ASC, 4 ASC

SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    overall_average
FROM 
    (WITH total_loans AS (
        SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS total_loans
        FROM 
            loan
        JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
        JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
        JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
        WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
        GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ),
    loans_with_no_issues AS (
        SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
        FROM 
            loan
        JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
        JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
        JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
        WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
            AND loan.status = 'C'
        GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ),
    percentage AS (
        SELECT 
            t.region,
            t.loan_size_category,

        FROM

    ),

                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'

WITH loan_data AS (
    SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans,
        SUM(CASE WHEN loan.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS loans_with_no_issues
    FROM 
        loan
    JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
    JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
    JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
    WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
    GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END
),
overall_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(loans_with_no_issues) AS overall_loans_with_no_issues,
        SUM(total_loans) AS overall_total_loans
    FROM 
        loan_data
)
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    (loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / total_loans) AS percentage_with_no_issues,
    (overall_loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / overall_total_loans) AS overall_average_percentage
FROM 
    loan_data
CROSS JOIN 
    overall_stats;

SELECT 
    s.CDSCode, 
    s.School, 
    s.Virtual, 
    f."Academic Year", 
    f."Enrollment (K-12)", 
    f."Free Meal Count (K-12)", 
    f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)", 
    ss.AvgScrRead, 
    ss.AvgScrMath, 
    ss.AvgScrWrite, 
    (ss.AvgScrRead + ss.AvgScrMath + ss.AvgScrWrite) AS TotalSATScore,
    CASE
        WHEN "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" <= 0.2 THEN 'Low Poverty'

SELECT 
    total_loans_table.region,
    total_loans_table.loan_size_category,
    (no_issues_loans_table.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / total_loans_table.total_loans) AS percentage_with_no_issues
FROM 
    (SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_loans
     FROM 
        loan
     JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
     JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
     JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
     WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
     GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END) AS total_loans_table
JOIN 
    (SELECT 
        district.A2 AS region,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END AS loan_size_category,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
     FROM 
        loan
     JOIN 
        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
     JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
     JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
     WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
        AND loan.status = 'C'
     GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END) AS no_issues_loans_table

    total_loans_table.region = no_issues_loans_table.region
    AND total_loans_table.loan_size_category = no_issues_loans_table.loan_size_category;

sql:
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    overall_average
FROM 
    (WITH total_loans AS (
        SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS total_loans
        FROM 
            loan
        JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
        JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
        JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
        WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
        GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ),
    loans_with_no_issues AS (
        SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
        FROM 
            loan
        JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
        JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
        JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
        WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
            AND loan.status = 'C'
        GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ),
    percentage AS (
        SELECT 
            t.region,
            t.loan_size_category,
            (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
        FROM 
            total_loans t
        JOIN 
            loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
    )
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        percentage,
        (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average
    FROM 
        percentage
    ORDER BY 
        region, loan_size_category)

sql:
SELECT 
    AVG(UA) AS "Average UA Index"
FROM (
    WITH LatestLabResults AS (
        SELECT 
            Patient.ID, 
            Laboratory.UA, 
            Patient.SEX,
            Laboratory.Date AS LabDate
        FROM 
            Patient
        JOIN 
            Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
        QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Patient.ID ORDER BY Laboratory.Date DESC) = 1
    )
    SELECT 
        ID, 
        UA, 
        SEX
    FROM 
        LatestLabResults
    WHERE 
        (SEX = 'M' AND UA < 8.0) OR (SEX = 'F' AND UA < 6.5)
) AS NormalUA;

sql:
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    overall_average
FROM 
    (WITH total_loans AS (
        SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS total_loans
        FROM 
            loan
        JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
        JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
        JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
        WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
        GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ),
    loans_with_no_issues AS (
        SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
        FROM 
            loan
        JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
        JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
        JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
        WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
            AND loan.status = 'C'
        GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ),
    percentage AS (
        SELECT 
            t.region,
            t.loan_size_category,
            (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
        FROM 
            total_loans t
        JOIN 
            loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
    )
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        percentage,
        (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average
    FROM 
        percentage
    ORDER BY 
        region, loan_size_category)

sql:
SELECT 
    AVG(UA) AS "Average UA Index"
FROM (
    WITH LatestLabResults AS (
        SELECT 
            Patient.ID, 
            Laboratory.UA, 
            Patient.SEX,
            Laboratory.Date AS LabDate
        FROM 
            Patient
        JOIN 
            Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
        QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Patient.ID ORDER BY Laboratory.Date DESC) = 1
    )
    SELECT 
        ID, 
        UA, 
        SEX
    FROM 
        LatestLabResults
    WHERE 
        (SEX = 'M' AND UA < 8.0) OR (SEX = 'F' AND UA < 6.5)
) AS NormalUA;

SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    overall_average
FROM 
    (WITH total_loans AS (
        SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS total_loans
        FROM 
            loan
        JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
        JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
        JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
        WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
        GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ),
    loans_with_no_issues AS (
        SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
        FROM 
            loan
        JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
        JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
        JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
        WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
            AND loan.status = 'C'
        GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ),
    percentage AS (
        SELECT 
            t.region,
            t.loan_size_category,
            (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
        FROM 
            total_loans t
        JOIN 
            loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
    )
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        percentage,
        (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average
    FROM 
        percentage
    ORDER BY 
        region)
ORDER BY 
    region;

sql:
SELECT 
    AVG(UA) AS "Average UA Index"
FROM (
    WITH LatestLabResults AS (
        SELECT 
            Patient.ID, 
            Laboratory.UA, 
            Patient.SEX,
            Laboratory.Date AS LabDate
        FROM 
            Patient
        JOIN 
            Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
        QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Patient.ID ORDER BY Laboratory.Date DESC) = 1
    )
    SELECT 
        ID, 
        UA, 
        SEX
    FROM 
        LatestLabResults
    WHERE 
        (SEX = 'M' AND UA < 8.0) OR (SEX = 'F' AND UA < 6.5)
) AS NormalUA;

sql:
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    overall_average
FROM 
    (WITH total_loans AS (
        SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS total_loans
        FROM 
            loan
        JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
        JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
        JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
        WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
        GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ),
    loans_with_no_issues AS (
        SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
        FROM 
            loan
        JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
        JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
        JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
        WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
            AND loan.status = 'C'
        GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ),
    percentage AS (
        SELECT 
            t.region,
            t.loan_size_category,
            (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
        FROM 
            total_loans t
        JOIN 
            loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
    )
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        percentage,
        (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average
    FROM 
        percentage
    ORDER BY 
        region, loan_size_category)
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;
exec_sql: SELECT region, loan_size_category, percentage, overall_average FROM (WITH total_loans AS (SELECT district.A2 AS region, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END AS loan_size_category, COUNT(*) AS total_loans FROM loan JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id JOIN client ON account.district_id = client.district_id JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id WHERE loan.amount < 100000 GROUP BY district.A2, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END), loans_with_no_issues AS (SELECT district.A2 AS region, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END AS loan_size_category, COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues FROM loan JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id JOIN client ON account.district_id = client.district_id JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id WHERE loan.amount < 100000 AND loan.status = 'C' GROUP BY district.A2, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END), percentage AS (SELECT t.region, t.loan_size_category, (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage FROM total_loans AS t JOIN loans_with_no_issues AS l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category) SELECT region, loan_size_category, percentage, (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average FROM percentage ORDER BY region, loan_size_category) ORDER BY region, loan_size_category, 1 ASC, 2 ASC, 3 ASC, 4 ASC

            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END) AS total_loans_table

        (SELECT

sql:
SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    overall_average
FROM 
    (WITH total_loans AS (
        SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS total_loans
        FROM 
            loan
        JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
        JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
        JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
        WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
        GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ),
    loans_with_no_issues AS (
        SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
        FROM 
            loan
        JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
        JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
        JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
        WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
            AND loan.status = 'C'
        GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ),
    percentage AS (
        SELECT 
            t.region,
            t.loan_size_category,
            (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
        FROM 
            total_loans t
        JOIN 
            loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
    )
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        percentage,
        (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average
    FROM 
        percentage
    ORDER BY 
        region, loan_size_category)
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;
exec_sql: SELECT region, loan_size_category, percentage, overall_average FROM (WITH total_loans AS (SELECT district.A2 AS region, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END AS loan_size_category, COUNT(*) AS total_loans FROM loan JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id JOIN client ON account.district_id = client.district_id JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id WHERE loan.amount < 100000 GROUP BY district.A2, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END), loans_with_no_issues AS (SELECT district.A2 AS region, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END AS loan_size_category, COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues FROM loan JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id JOIN client ON account.district_id = client.district_id JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id WHERE loan.amount < 100000 AND loan.status = 'C' GROUP BY district.A2, CASE WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small' WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END), percentage AS (SELECT t.region, t.loan_size_category, (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage FROM total_loans AS t JOIN loans_with_no_issues AS l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category) SELECT region, loan_size_category, percentage, (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average FROM percentage ORDER BY region, loan_size_category) ORDER BY region, loan_size_category, 1 ASC, 2 ASC, 3 ASC, 4 ASC

SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    overall_average
FROM 
    (WITH total_loans AS (
        SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS total_loans
        FROM 
            loan
        JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
        JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
        JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
        WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
        GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ),
    loans_with_no_issues AS (
        SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
        FROM 
            loan
        JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
        JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
        JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
        WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
            AND loan.status = 'C'
        GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ),
    percentage AS (
        SELECT 
            t.region,
            t.loan_size_category,
            (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
        FROM

    total_loans_table.loan_size_category,

            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'

     FROM 
        loan

        account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
     JOIN 
        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
     JOIN 
        district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
     WHERE 
        loan.amount < 100000
     GROUP BY 
        district.A2,
        CASE 
            WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
            WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Large'
        END) AS total_loans_table

    (SELECT

        client ON account.district_id = client.district_id

    (SELECT 
        total_loans_table.region,

        (no_issues_loans_table.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / total_loans_table.total_loans) AS percentage_with_no_issues,
        (no_issues_loans_table.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / total_loans_table.total_loans - 67.43895503381425) AS difference_from_average
     FROM 
        (SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS total_loans
         FROM 
            loan

            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
         JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
         JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
         WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
         GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'

        (SELECT

    SUM(CASE WHEN atom.element = 'f' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS molecules_with_fluorine,
    SUM(CASE WHEN atom.element = 'f' THEN bond_count ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN atom.element = 'f' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS average_bonds_with_fluorine,

    SELECT molecule.molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS bond_count

    WHERE molecule.label = '+'
    GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id
) AS subquery

JOIN atom ON molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id;

sql:
SELECT 
    region,
    ROUND((gold_cards_before_1998 * 100.0 / total_gold_cards), 2) AS percentage_before_1998
FROM 
    (
        SELECT 
            dist.A3 AS region,
            COUNT(CASE WHEN c.issued < '1998-01-01' THEN 1 END) AS gold_cards_before_1998,
            COUNT(*) AS total_gold_cards
        FROM 
            card c
        JOIN 
            disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
        JOIN 
            client cl ON d.client_id = cl.client_id
        JOIN 
            district dist ON cl.district_id = dist.district_id
        WHERE 
            c.type = 'gold'
        GROUP BY 
            dist.A3
    );
